notes:
Review playback: Center the previous-segment, play and next-segment controls. Choose whole-video looping (the default), current-segment looping or no loop. The clock uses minutes and seconds, strip zoom controls respect their limits, and transport icons are consistent in Review, Timeline and fullscreen. The separate play-from-beginning button has been removed.
Review navigation: Segment chips and the chapter band are read-only. Click or scrub to navigate without accidentally changing durations or chapter boundaries; use Timeline to edit chapter starts, names and removal. Changing a loop mode at the end does not start paused prototype playback.
Original subtitles: When only translated captions exist, use the dashed Original chip to build the original caption layer from its transcript. It shares the translation style for bilingual stacking and supports Undo. Review's Translate to action opens the translation settings in Timeline; unavailable translation actions are hidden.
Subtitle fixes: Switching an existing caption style preset no longer fails with an invalid document change. The prototype also restores a removed subtitle track with its previous styling and placement instead of overlapping the remaining track.
Packaging: Desktop, Web and Runtime share one copy of each editor and preview WASM module. Windows installed and portable packages now share bundled fonts across preview and the export worker, with final-package resource checks.
Local audio engine: Upgrade bundled audio.cpp to 0.9.2-drama3-base-small and update archive integrity records and third-party license notices.
Distribution requirements: Mac packages require signing and notarization. Windows CPU, CUDA and Vulkan packages are unsigned and require AVX2 and the Microsoft Visual C++ v14 x64 Redistributable. Automated release checks do not cover UI/export workflows, live model or GPU inference, physical IME candidate windows or paid agent calls.
